summary: RETEST of iteration_152 fixes. Backend: test_flight_itinerary_merge.py 9/9 pass (same-direction merge replaces leg 600->600, PATCH segments=[] clears legacy fields, confirm-all auto-merge). Frontend web (390x844), tested end to end with a TEST comp holding 2 flight cards plus 3 injected flight drafts: FlightMergePicker opens on web, lists both cards, puts 'Best match' on the matching Delta card, and has a new-card option and Cancel. Fill -> Delta card went from $320 (300+20 tax) to $450 cost / $450 paid / $0 balance, with no stale taxes, shown on competition detail. Trip total $980 / due $530 is correct. 'Add as a new flight card' -> separate American card ($380). Cancel -> picker closes, spinner stops, draft stays pending. Flight editor functional updates: fast fills in the app keep airline + flight #. Fare total $255 and save are correct. Trash target is 44x44. Money tab: 'More filters' toggle hides/shows competition/travel-type/date filters, All/Expenses/Travel chips stay visible, '(whole family)' label shows with athlete filter, kind=travel/expenses filter the rows correctly.

minor.issue: Fix to use household ids is present in code (inbox.py L656-660) but was not exercised live: the demo user's household has only 1 member. Verified by code review only.

ui_bugs.issue: Hotel/car 'Looks like a duplicate' still uses a multi-button Alert.alert in a Promise. That is a no-op on web, so Save spins forever there (same root cause as the old flight bug). Not hit in this run, found by code review.
The 'Added' / 'Flight card updated…' Alert is a no-op on web. The draft quietly disappears with no confirmation.

Text typed into the first field within ~1s of a full page load (direct URL) is wiped, probably by a screen remount during auth/root hydration. In-app navigation and typing after the app settles both work. Web automation edge case only.

issues: The travel subtotal strip still shows with the kind=Expenses filter. Probably intended, but it may confuse users.
Floating star FAB still overlaps the right edge of the bottom-most card / Save flight button (booking-save-btn)
